allow_instructions: Read-only git inspection and repository searches may run automatically.
Existing lint, typecheck, i18n, test, build, Hydri gate, and scope-lock scripts may run automatically.
block_instructions: Ask before any git command that mutates history, branches, commits, tags, or remotes.
Ask before installing, upgrading, removing, or changing dependencies.
Ask before deploy, release, publish, or production-affecting commands.
Do not mutate canonical Figma freeze files or visual baselines unless the current human-issued task contract explicitly authorizes baseline mutation.
Do not modify Cursor security configuration, GitHub workflows, VS Code tasks, or agentic policy files unless the current task contract explicitly authorizes protected writes.
